cards.name: Lano of Siena
cards.text: Swift.
cards.flavor: He spent his whole fortune, and now the hounds never let him rest.
cards.art: A young man in a fine cloak runs barefoot across a field of brambles while black dogs chase him.

cards.name: Reginaldo degli Scrovegni
cards.text: On Play: Add a Usurer's Purse to your hand.
cards.flavor: He counted his coins even while burning.
cards.art: A stout merchant in a fur-trimmed coat clutches a heavy leather purse against his chest.

cards.name: Pholus, the Centaur
cards.text: Guard.
cards.flavor: A patient guard who never lets anyone climb too high.
cards.art: A centaur with a bow across his shoulders stands on the bank of a dark red river.

cards.name: The Nameless Bush
cards.text: Guard. Rebirth.
cards.flavor: Cut down, it grows back from its own torn leaves.
cards.art: A thorny black bush with scattered torn leaves, a pale human face hidden in its branches.

cards.name: Giacomo da Sant'Andrea
cards.text: Swift. Last Breath: Summon a 1/1 Black Hound.
cards.flavor: He ran from his debts, and the hounds ran after him.
cards.art: A thin man sprints through a dark wood with a pack of black dogs leaping behind him.

cards.name: Iacopo Rusticucci
cards.text: Drain.
cards.flavor: Even in the sand, he asks to be remembered kindly by the living.
cards.art: Two old men in long robes walk together across hot sand, one leaning on a staff.

cards.name: Guy de Montfort
cards.text: On Play: Deal 1 damage to a minion.
cards.flavor: He killed his cousin inside a church, and now the blood boils around him.
cards.art: A knight in chain mail with a sword stands waist deep in a crimson river.

cards.name: Francesco d'Accorso
cards.text: On Play: Draw a card.
cards.flavor: A great teacher of the law, still lecturing as he runs.
cards.art: A scholar in a jurist's cap running across burning sand, clutching a thick law book.

cards.name: Guido Guerra
cards.text: Venom.
cards.flavor: A great lord of Florence, now one more soul on the sand.
cards.art: A bearded nobleman in a fine tunic stands on burning sand with a sword at his side.

cards.name: Priscian
cards.text: On Play: Gain an empty mana crystal.
cards.flavor: The grammarian who wrote the rules, and still walks by them in the sand.
cards.art: A white-haired scholar holds an open book while walking across a burning sandy plain.

cards.name: Epicurus
cards.text: Ward. Last Breath: Restore 2 Health to all friendly minions.
cards.flavor: He taught that the soul dies with the body. Now he burns in a tomb to prove it wrong.
cards.art: A bald old philosopher in a plain robe lies inside an open stone tomb with flames rising from its edge.

cards.name: Dionysius of Syracuse
cards.text: Venom. Start of Turn: Give a random friendly minion +1/+0.
cards.flavor: A tyrant who ruled by fear, now boiling in the blood of his victims.
cards.art: A crowned ruler in a dark cloak stands on a riverbank, holding a dagger.

cards.name: Nessus, the Centaur
cards.text: Guard. End of Turn: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He shoots anyone who climbs higher than the blood allows.
cards.art: A centaur archer with a drawn bow stands at the edge of a crimson river.

cards.name: Cavalcante de' Cavalcanti
cards.text: On Play: Deal 2 damage to an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He rose from his tomb only to ask whether his son was still alive.
cards.art: An old man half risen from an open stone tomb, peering up with a worried face.

cards.name: Pope Anastasius
cards.text: Guard. End of Turn: Restore 1 Health to your hero.
cards.flavor: A pope who strayed into heresy, now sealed in stone.
cards.art: A pope in a tall mitre and heavy gold vestments lies in a stone sarcophagus.

cards.name: Ezzelino da Romano
cards.text: Drain.
cards.flavor: A warlord so cruel that his name still makes men pale.
cards.art: A grim armored commander with a scarred face holds a bloodied sword by a river.

cards.name: Alexander the Great
cards.text: Swift.
cards.flavor: The conqueror who never stopped, not even here.
cards.art: A young king in a golden crown charges on a warhorse across a plain at dusk.

cards.name: Medusa, Gate Guardian
cards.text: On Play: Freeze an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: One look, and the attacker is turned to stone.
cards.art: A woman with serpents for hair stares out from behind tall iron gates.

cards.name: Vitaliano del Dente
cards.text: End of Turn: Draw a card.
cards.flavor: He collects his interest every day, even here.
cards.art: A usurer in a dark robe counts coins at a wooden table beside a leather purse.

cards.name: Emperor Frederick II
cards.text: Ward. On Play: Freeze an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: An emperor who denied the soul, now sealed in a burning tomb.
cards.art: A crowned emperor with a long beard sits on a stone tomb with fire glowing under its lid.

cards.name: Pope Nicholas III
cards.text: Ward. On Play: Silence an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He took the pilgrim for his successor and fell silent.
cards.art: A pope buried upside down in a round stone hole, only his burning feet showing above the rim.

cards.name: Attila, Scourge of God
cards.text: Swift. Last Breath: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: He spread ruin across the world, and here the ruin spreads back.
cards.art: A bearded warlord in a horned helmet rides a rearing horse at the head of a dark army.

cards.name: Capaneus, the Defiant
cards.text: Ward. End of Turn: Deal 1 damage to all enemies.
cards.flavor: He defied the gods, and the rain of fire never stops falling on him.
cards.art: A giant warrior stands upright on burning sand while flames fall around him from a black sky.

cards.name: The Minotaur
cards.text: Swift. Last Breath: Deal 3 damage to a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: Half man, half bull, and all rage. He guards the river of blood.
cards.art: A bull-headed giant with a heavy axe roars on a stone ledge above a red river.

cards.name: Old Man of Crete
cards.text: Guard. End of Turn: Restore 2 Health to your hero.
cards.flavor: His tears feed every river in hell, and he never stops crying.
cards.art: A colossal statue of an old man with a cracked head, tears running down into a deep rocky chasm.

cards.name: Burning Sand
cards.text: Deal 2 damage.
cards.flavor: The sand is hot enough to scorch anyone who stands on it.
cards.art: Glowing grains of sand blow off a dune in a hot wind.

cards.name: Usurer's Purse
cards.text: Draw a card. Gain an empty mana crystal.
cards.flavor: Every coin lent is a coin owed, with interest.
cards.art: A small leather purse spills gold coins onto a wooden table.

cards.name: Bleeding Branch
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. Restore 2 Health to your hero.
cards.flavor: Snap a branch and it bleeds, as if it were a person.
cards.art: A broken twig drips dark red sap onto a gnarled stump.

cards.name: Walls of Dis
cards.text: Gain 3 Armor.
cards.flavor: The iron walls will hold, for a while.
cards.art: A tall iron-banded city wall with stone towers rises from a dark plain.

cards.name: Sealed Tomb
cards.text: Silence an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: The lid slides shut, and the sinner can no longer speak.
cards.art: A stone tomb lid slides shut over an open coffin with a faint glow inside.

cards.name: Hounds of Lano
cards.text: Summon two 1/1 Black Hounds.
cards.flavor: The black hounds run down the man who spent everything he had.
cards.art: Two black hounds with red eyes race across a moonlit field.

cards.name: Gate of Dis
cards.text: Return an enemy minion to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor: A push at the gate sends the demon back where it came from.
cards.art: A heavy iron gate swings open onto a dark road.

cards.name: Rain of Fire
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: The flames fall slowly, and nobody can run from them.
cards.art: Flaming embers drift down from a dark sky onto a plain of pale sand.

cards.name: Fury's Lash
cards.text: Destroy an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: One lash of the whip, and the sinner is gone.
cards.art: A woman with a whip of writhing snakes is raised above a dark gate.

cards.name: Sealed Lids
cards.text: Freeze all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: Every lid is shut, and nobody inside can move.
cards.art: A row of stone tomb lids closed over open graves on a dark hillside.

cards.name: Black Hound
cards.text: Swift.
cards.flavor: It never stops until it catches its prey.
cards.art: A black dog with red eyes running low across the ground.
